name: Customizable Roll Listener
description:
# Customizable Roll Listener

Run chat commands automatically when a matching roll or message appears in chat: play a sound on a critical hit, roll on a fumble table on a natural 1, post a reminder when a character uses a certain attack, and so on.

**Version 2.0.0 is a full rewrite.** It reads roll templates, plain chat, emotes, `/roll` results, rollable table results and the output of other mods, and has an inspector that shows exactly what a message contains (useful for Beacon sheets such as D&D 2024). Existing v1 listeners are upgraded automatically and the v1 `!crl \\create` style commands keep working.

## Getting started

1. Type `!crl` in chat, or open the **Customizable Roll Listener - Command Deck** handout.
2. Click **New Listener** and give it a name.
3. Choose what it listens for: roll templates, text, characters, and roll results such as *critical*, *fumble*, a natural 20 or a total of 15 or more.
4. Enter the commands to run, for example `!roll20AM --audio,play|Crit` or `/em lands a devastating blow!`.

Type `!crl help` for every command. The **Customizable Roll Listener - Help** handout is created in the Journal on startup.

## Features

* Filters for roll templates, message types, text (plain or regular expression), speakers, characters and players.
* Roll checks: critical, fumble, success and failure (dropped dice are ignored), totals and natural die results, optionally limited to one die size.
* Matches rollable table results by their text.
* Placeholders such as `${who}`, `${character}` and `${total}` in commands.
* Commands can be sent as CRL or as the character who rolled.
* Per-listener on/off switch, cooldown, ordering and "stop after this one".
* Inspector, test button, and loop protection that switches off a listener that keeps triggering itself.
* Listener commands are kept as abilities on the hidden **Customizable Roll Listener** character, so `@{}`, `%{}` and inline rolls can be edited in the Journal.

Original mod by Scott C., with version 1.1 fixes by The Aaron. Version 2 is maintained by MidNiteShadow7.

useroptions.name: speaker
useroptions.description: Who listener commands are sent as, unless a listener says otherwise: crl (as "CRL", like version 1) or roller (as the character, or player, whose message triggered the listener).

useroptions.name: listenToMods
useroptions.description: Whether chat sent by other mods (for example ScriptCards or Group Check) can trigger listeners. CRL never reacts to its own messages.

useroptions.name: language
useroptions.description: Language code for GM messages, menus and handouts. Run !crl config language to see all supported codes.
